reason: Provides DeepSeek Harness voice input by capturing microphone audio, sending it to Volcengine Doubao streaming ASR, and incrementally inserting editable transcripts into the active input field.

summaries.zh: 通过火山引擎豆包流式语音识别，将麦克风语音实时转写并回填到 DeepSeek Harness 输入框。
summaries.en: Adds voice input to DeepSeek Harness by streaming microphone audio to Volcengine Doubao ASR and incrementally filling the input field with editable transcripts.

capabilities: Captures microphone audio in the browser
Streams audio to Volcengine Doubao ASR through a host WebSocket relay
Streams recognized text into editable input fields
Stores and uses Volcengine authentication credentials
Provides recording controls, hotwords, language, shortcut, and duration settings
